title: File:NARA 111-CCV-570-CC44322 4th Infantry Division soldier securing landing zone Quang Ngai 1967.jpg
author: Photographer SP5 Robert C. Lafoon, Department of the Army Special Photo Office (DASPO)
description: Members of Company D, 2nd Battalion, 35th Infantry, 3rd Brigade, 4th Infantry Division, who came in on the first wave of helicopters secure the landing zone for the remainder of company during a helicopter combat assault and a one day search and destroy mission in the Quang Nagi Province, 8km west of Duc Pho.

title: File:SAS soldiers return to Nui Dat after a patrol.jpg
author: Fairley, John Geoffrey
description: Phuoc Tuy Province, South Vietnam. May 1970. The Special Air Services (SAS) men return to the 1st Australian Task Force (1ATF) base at Nui Dat. Leading from the chopper (helicopter) is patrol commander Sergeant John O'Keefe of Balga, WA. Chris Bellis is crouched down with a 16mm Bell and Howell cine camera.

title: File:809th MRBC Zero and Qualify on New M4 Carbines (8317418).jpg
author: U.S. Army photo by Miriam Schraml
description: U.S. Soldiers assigned to the 809th Multi-Role Bridge Company (MBRC), 15th Engineer Battalion, zero and qualify on newly issued M4 carbines on 7th ATC's Grafenwoehr Training Area, March 28, 2024. The 809th MBRC is a new unit that is standing up at Tower Barracks, and is the only MBRC stationed throughout Europe and Africa. (U.S. Army photo by Miriam Schraml)

title: File:A U.S. Soldier fires an M4 carbine rifle from the kneeling unsupported firing position during the M4 qualification event at Fort Bragg, N.C., Aug. 26, 2014 140826-A-VI439-004.jpg

description: A U.S. Soldier fires an M4 carbine rifle from the kneeling unsupported firing position during the M4 qualification event at Fort Bragg, N.C., Aug. 26, 2014. The qualification was one of several events during the U.S. Army Forces Command Noncommissioned Officer/Soldier of the Year Best Warrior competition.
